notes.title: Officially support "Remote Play Together"
notes.content:

Go grab your controller and play with your friends even without physically being together!!

・Xbox 360 Controller

・Xbox One Controller

・PlayStation Controller

notes.title: Triangle Service Score Attack Competitions!
notes.content:
To celebrate the Steam Summer Sale... http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Degica
...we have two awesome scoring competitions running throughout the sale! 

One in DELTAZEAL...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/379520/
...and the other in XIIZEAL!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364250/
The competitions are running from the moment the Summer Sale starts (6/23) to the moment it ends (7/4). In both competitions, the rules are the same: make sure you are one of the top 3 scores recorded between the competition dates in Stage 1 Score Attack, Normal difficult, and you win the prize.

You must be set to Normal difficulty with “Save Replays” set to “On” in the game’s settings. Replays must be submitted to be counted. Stage 1 Score Attack can easily be unlocked by completing Stage 1 in Arcade Mode.

The prize for the DELTAZEAL competition: a prerelease copy of Triangle Service’s EXZEAL

The prize for the XIIZEAL competitions: a prerelease copy of Triangle Service’s TRIZEAL Remix.

So fire up your boosters, and zealously strive for the perfect score!

notes.title: DeltaZeal V1.0.3 Update - New Replay Features
notes.content:
[h1]DeltaZeal V1.03 - 12/15/2015[/h1]
[list][*]You can now record replay videos longer than 30 minutes (up to 60 minutes).
[*]Added a Fast Forward feature to replay playback.  Use the "X" button to toggle fast forward on and off.
[*]Corrected an error where the keyboard would start both P1 and P2 at the same time.
[*]Optimized text display so menus and leaderboards should be more responsive.
[*]Corrected an error that could occur when accessing an empty leaderboard.[/list]

notes.title: DeltaZeal is now LIVE!
notes.content:
DeltaZeal is ready to play!  I've had tremendous fun guiding DeltaZeal through the localization process, and I hope that you will now enjoy this classic arcade game just as much as I do.

In addition to DeltaZeal, we've also released the soundtracks for DeltaZeal and XIIZeal:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/406490/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/406480/

This is the second Triangle Service shmup on Steam, following XIIZeal which we released earlier this year.  If you don't have XIIZeal already, please consider picking up the "Shooting Love Anniversary" pack, which includes both DeltaZeal *and* XIIZeal, along with the soundtracks for both games.  It's a great value if you're a fan of shooting games!
